note: Modern coastlines and a schematic spatial interpolation of dated campaign localities, not surveyed wartime frontlines. Thailand red denotes its agreement permitting Japanese passage; initial blue is a presentation baseline, not Allied membership. Noon is a scenario display convention for the Thailand date. East Malaysia is outside this Malayan campaign and retains its baseline color.
